securityControls.threat: Replay attack where attacker re-submits previously approved callback payload
securityControls.mechanism: Single-use cryptographic nonces and consumedTokens Map
securityControls.evidence: Second execution rejected with 'has already been consumed'

securityControls.threat: Execution of an outdated or expired approval token
securityControls.mechanism: expiresAt epoch timestamp boundary (24 hour ceiling)
securityControls.evidence: Expired action token rejected with 'Action token expired at...'

securityControls.threat: Unauthorized or unknown Telegram user clicks approval button
securityControls.evidence: User not authorized to execute actions on this office task

securityControls.threat: Approval of revision A when designer has already started revision B
securityControls.mechanism: token.revisionId checked against current task revision
securityControls.evidence: Action token was generated for revision rev_1, but current task revision is rev_2

securityControls.threat: Attacker injects forged identity parameters into Telegram Web App initData
securityControls.mechanism: HMAC-SHA256 signature verification over alphabetically sorted key-value pairs with WebAppData secret
securityControls.evidence: Tampered initData hash rejected; valid initData grants authenticated operator session
